counterfactual_missing_items: Tongue metastasis not addressed in R2
R2 lacks the tongue nodule and its pathological confirmation
R2 does not integrate the metastatic spread
decisive_items: Nodular growth observed on the mid third of the tongue
Neoplastic subepithelial proliferation, consisting of epithelioid cells in the tongue
Neoplastic cells immunoreactive for calretinin, confirming mesothelial origin
response.rationale: R4 integrates the primary pleural mesothelioma with the tongue nodule showing mesothelial markers, correctly diagnosing metastasis. R2 only covers the primary pleural disease, missing the key metastatic finding.

rejected.why: Fails to account for the tongue nodule and its mesothelial origin, thus incomplete for the most likely diagnosis.
